summary: Traws Pharma, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $5,575,709 of its common stock under an existing ATM agreement with Citizens JMP Securities. The ATM was established March 10, 2025, and sales may occur at market prices; the closing price on July 7, 2026, was $0.70 per share. Citizens receives a 3.0% commission. The offering is a routine equity shelf takedown to raise working capital, not a special situation. No advisory or board recommendation details are provided. Watch for dilution given the low stock price; risk-arb is not applicable as this is a standard capital raise.
